note: Three post-2000 NRTIs (censavudine/BMS-986001, rovafovir etalafenamide/GS-9131, azvudine/FNC) went into patients on the standard NRTI cell-culture package (potency on wild-type and NRTI-resistant HIV-1, intracellular triphosphate persistence, polymerase-gamma/mtDNA sparing) plus rodent/monkey toxicology; censavudine matched in monotherapy and Phase 2b before BMS dropped it, GS-9131's cell-culture prediction of activity against NRTI-resistant virus failed in a functional-monotherapy Phase 2, and azvudine's Chinese Phase 2/3 results behind its 2021 NMPA approval are unpublished, so it scores nothing.
label: HIV NRTIs (next-generation)

engagement.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
engagement.note: 4'-Ethynyl-d4T (censavudine) characterised in CEM/PBMC culture: fivefold more potent than stavudine, less mitochondrial toxicity; the class's cell-culture package opens here.
engagement.quote: After examining a series of 2',3'-didehydro-3'-deoxy-4'-substituted thymidine (4'-substituted D4T) analogs, 4'-ethynyl D4T was found to have a fivefold-better antiviral effect and to cause less cellular and mitochondrial toxicity than D4T.
engagement.judgement: Track opens with the first cell-culture characterisation of a member (4'-Ed4T is censavudine, so product_in_model is true); the same CEM/PBMC/site-directed-mutant package carried GS-9131 (Cihlar 2008, 10.1128/AAC.01215-07) and azvudine (Wang 2014, 10.1371/journal.pone.0105617). model_filed is null throughout: none of the three members has an FDA NDA (manifest rows 4084/5250/6776 read 'no NDA/BLA'), so there is no review package to check. readout_tier is proximal because the model reads viral replication, which in people is plasma HIV-1 RNA.

engagement.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
engagement.note: Ten-day censavudine monotherapy cut HIV-1 RNA 0.97-1.28 log10 at 100-600 mg once daily: the RT target the cell assay predicted was engaged in patients.
engagement.quote: Median decrease in plasma HIV-1 RNA from baseline to day 11 was 0.97, 1.15, 1.28, and 1.15 log10 copies/mL for BMS-986001 at 100, 200, 300, and 600 mg, respectively.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; registered only in EudraCT (2008-004810-29), no results record located.
engagement.magnitude_basis: viral-load decline present as predicted; the cell assay predicts antiviral activity, not a log-drop
engagement.reason: Monotherapy viral load fell as predicted
engagement.judgement: Engagement read as the proximal readout (plasma viral load) moving under monotherapy, because RT-resistance mapping in patients is confounded for this class (lamivudine was co-dosed in the Phase 2b and the GS-9131 trial posted no resistance read-out). comparison_stated false: the abstract reports the clinical data without juxtaposing the cell-culture prediction, so the model side is Dutschman 2004. magnitude direction_only because the cell assay predicts activity, not a log-drop. The GS-9131 functional-monotherapy failure (2021) is scored once, in efficacy and its derived dose entry, and not repeated here: whether its small viral-load movement was an engagement failure (intracellular diphosphate not reached) or a susceptibility failure cannot be separated because human PK was never published; a stricter reader may also mark this cell contra from 2021. Azvudine: Sun 2020 (10.1021/acs.jmedchem.0c00940) reports intracellular FNC-triphosphate retention and A3G restoration in FNC-treated patients at abstract level only, and its HIV Phase 2/3 (NCT04109183, NCT04303598) have no posted results and no located publication, so it adds no entry.

dose.model: Cell-culture potency plus intracellular triphosphate persistence as the exposure and regimen target
dose.note: Intracellular 4'-Ed4T-triphosphate persisted after drug removal in CEM cells, the once-daily regimen rationale; no numeric exposure target was stated.
dose.quote: Most importantly, 4'-Ed4TTP, the active metabolite of 4'-Ed4T, persisted significantly longer than 4'-Ed4TDP and 4'-Ed4TMP after drug removal.
dose.judgement: The dose track is the same cell system read as potency plus intracellular triphosphate persistence; it opens in 2009 with the member's own retention paper because the 2004 paper states no exposure or regimen target. margin_stated false: no tolerability margin sits on this track; the nonclinical tox paper (Guha 2014) gives monkey findings at 200-300 mg/kg/d but no human-equivalent margin, so decision 16 is not invoked.

dose.model: Cell-culture potency plus intracellular triphosphate persistence as the exposure and regimen target
dose.note: Once-daily 100-600 mg censavudine gave dose-proportional PK and exposures on the plateau of the exposure-response curve; all doses were active.
dose.short: All once-daily doses on response plateau
dose.quote: Plasma area under the curve correlated with the antiviral activity of BMS-986001, indicating that area under the curves produced by 100-600 mg doses were on the upper end of the exposure-response curve.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; the model stated no numeric exposure target, so only the once-daily regimen prediction is testable.
dose.magnitude_basis: once-daily 100-600 mg all on the exposure-response plateau; no numeric exposure target to place within a fold
dose.judgement: Called same because every once-daily dose from 100 mg sat on the exposure-response plateau, consistent with the triphosphate-persistence prediction of once-daily dosing; the model gave no numeric target, so magnitude is direction_only. Consistent but not added as an entry: Phase 2b 100/200/400 mg all matched tenofovir DF at week 24 (Gupta 2016). The healthy-volunteer SAD study (Urata 2014, 10.1002/jcph.252) showed linear PK with no food effect and stated no target.

dose.model: Cell-culture potency plus intracellular triphosphate persistence as the exposure and regimen target
dose.note: GS-9131 60 then 180 mg once daily in NRTI-resistant patients: mean declines 0.13 and 0.29 log10, below the 0.5 log10 bar; programme abandoned.
dose.quote: The study was terminated because a majority of Sentinel Cohort 2 participants did not meet primary endpoint of HIV-1 RNA > 0.5 log10 decrease from baseline through up to 14 days of therapy.
dose.confidence_note: Human plasma PK and intracellular GS-9148-diphosphate were study objectives but were never posted or published; 'reached' is inferred from the sponsor's threefold escalation and abandonment, not measured.
dose.judgement: Derived from the efficacy contra under the 'reached, failed, abandoned' row. 'Reached' is inferred, not measured: the protocol attributed the 60 mg sentinel result to possibly suboptimal dosing and duration, Gilead escalated threefold to 180 mg for 14 days, failed again and stopped the programme rather than escalate further; no later GS-9131 trial is registered. If PK ever shows the dog-derived intracellular target was not reached, this entry stays contra (PK row) and the efficacy entry reverts to untested. source_tier 3 (registry results record, posted 2021-01-05); model side Cihlar 2008.

dose.model: Beagle dog oral PK with intracellular GS-9148-diphosphate loading of PBMCs
dose.note: Beagle dogs dosed 3 mg/kg loaded PBMCs with >9 uM GS-9148-diphosphate (half-life >24 h), the once-daily regimen basis; human intracellular levels never published.
dose.short: Dog PBMC loading, never checked in humans
dose.quote: Oral administration of GS-9131 to beagle dogs at a dose of 3 mg/kg of body weight resulted in high and persistent levels of GS-9148 diphosphate in peripheral blood mononuclear cells
dose.judgement: Separate animal track: the beagle PBMC loading, with the 19 h GS-9148-diphosphate half-life in activated CD4 cells (Ray 2008, 10.1128/AAC.01209-07), was the once-daily regimen rationale. No human intracellular diphosphate or plasma PK for GS-9131 is public (no CT.gov Phase 1 record found; the Phase 2 PK objective was never reported), so the track is untested, not contra. CROI 2017 abstract 436 (White et al.) restated the same package and projected efficacy in patients with NRTI resistance, but a conference abstract is not an admissible source and is not cited.

efficacy.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
efficacy.note: Cell-culture replication (CEM/PBMC) was the efficacy model for 4'-Ed4T; no animal efficacy model was used for any member.
efficacy.short: Cell replication assay is the efficacy model
efficacy.quote: Since 4'-ethynyl D4T has increased anti-HIV activity and decreased toxicity and interacts favorably with other currently used anti-HIV drugs, it should be considered for further development as an anti-HIV drug.
efficacy.judgement: No animal efficacy model was relied on by any member (none located for 4'-Ed4T, GS-9131 or FNC in PubMed/Europe PMC; the FNC macaque work is SARS-CoV-2), so the cell is a populated cell-culture track, not an empty list. patient_trials is empty on the opener.

efficacy.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
efficacy.note: Phase 2a: ten days of censavudine monotherapy produced substantial HIV-1 RNA declines in every dose group, as cell culture predicted.
efficacy.quote: Administration of BMS-986001 for 10 days resulted in substantial decreases in plasma HIV-1 RNA levels for all dose groups and was generally well tolerated.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; endpoint ranking in the EudraCT record (2008-004810-29) not read.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: antiviral activity present as predicted; no effect-size prediction from the cell assay

patient_trials.quote: Median decrease in plasma HIV-1 RNA from baseline to day 11 was 0.97, 1.15, 1.28, and 1.15 log10 copies/mL for BMS-986001 at 100, 200, 300, and 600 mg, respectively.

efficacy.judgement: Phase 2a monotherapy scored as the proof-of-concept read-out; endpoint_role set to primary because antiviral activity was a stated objective of the study, with the caveat that the EudraCT record was not read to confirm its ranking. comparison_stated false: the abstract does not juxtapose the cell data, so the model side is Dutschman 2004. Subjects were treatment-experienced but off ART for 3 months or more, and the one subject with a single TAM responded, consistent with the Li 2013 cross-resistance profile (10.1128/AAC.01195-13). Registered only in EudraCT, so nct is null in patient_trials.

efficacy.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
efficacy.note: Phase 2b AI467003: censavudine 100-400 mg with efavirenz/lamivudine matched tenofovir DF at week 24 (81-94% vs 89% <50 copies/mL); BMS still dropped it.
efficacy.short: Censavudine matched tenofovir DF at week 24
efficacy.quote: BMS-986001 had similar efficacy to that of tenofovir disoproxil fumarate and was associated with a smaller decrease in bone mineral density; however, greater resistance and gains in both peripheral and central fat accumulation were recorded for the investigational drug.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; Lancet HIV full text paywalled.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: non-inferior response rates at every dose; the cell assay predicts activity, not a response rate

patient_trials.quote: 62 (94%) of 66 in the 400 mg group achieved HIV-1 RNA less than 50 copies per mL, compared with 88 (89%) of 99 in the tenofovir disoproxil fumarate group (modified intention-to-treat population).

efficacy.judgement: Strengthening entry for the same member: the Phase 2b primary endpoint was met at every dose. Year is the Lancet HIV epub (2015-12-12); NCT01489046 never posted results, so registry_date is null. Model side is Li 2013 (site-directed and clinical-isolate susceptibility on the same panel). BMS's discontinuation followed the fat-gain and resistance findings, not an efficacy failure, so neg is unavailable: the model's own potency data were not below the class bar. The 2% NRTI-RAM rate versus 0% on tenofovir DF is consistent with M184V selection in culture (Nitanda 2005, 10.1128/AAC.49.8.3355-3360.2005) but cannot be attributed with lamivudine co-dosed, so it is not scored under engagement.

efficacy.model: HIV-1 replication in cell culture (CEM/PBMC/MT-4) with site-directed NRTI-resistant mutants, clinical isolates and in-vitro resistance selection
efficacy.note: Cell culture predicted GS-9131 unaffected by K65R/L74V/M184V; in NRTI-resistant patients, functional monotherapy at 60 and 180 mg missed the >0.5 log10 bar.
efficacy.quote: The study was terminated because a majority of Sentinel Cohort 2 participants did not meet primary endpoint of HIV-1 RNA > 0.5 log10 decrease from baseline through up to 14 days of therapy.
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry results record only (21 participants; sentinel cohorts 60 mg mean -0.13 log10 at day 11, 180 mg mean -0.29 log10 at day 15); enrolled genotypes and human PK are not public; no publication located.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: predicted full susceptibility (fold change <1 for K65R/L74V/M184V, <=1.5 for >=4 TAMs) versus mean 0.13-0.29 log10 declines in patients; no numeric effect-size prediction

patient_trials.quote: GS-9131 did not meet the targeted antiviral response

efficacy.reason: Cell-predicted activity vs resistant virus failed
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level prediction (which genotypes respond) and the track's only contra. The model (Cihlar 2008; restated at CROI 2017) said K65R, L74V and M184V alone or combined did not reduce GS-9131 activity and four or more TAMs gave fold changes of at most 1.5; the Phase 2 enrolled adults failing 2 NRTI + NNRTI regimens with a protocol-defined NRTI-resistance profile, and the drug missed the >0.5 log10 bar at 60 mg (mean -0.13 at day 11) and 180 mg (mean -0.29 at day 15); the study was terminated and no later GS-9131 trial exists. Caveats holding confidence at medium: enrolled genotypes are not public (if dominated by Q151M-complex or T69-insertion viruses the model would not have predicted response), human PK was never published, and the registry's statement is the termination reason rather than a model comparison. Under the one-drug-contra-beats-same rule the track reads contra from 2021 although censavudine matched. Azvudine's 2021 NMPA approval rests on unpublished Chinese Phase 3 data (NCT04303598, status unknown, no results), so it is not scored.

safety.model: DNA polymerase-gamma / mtDNA-depletion assays in cell culture (CEM; later 19-day primary human kidney, muscle and adipocyte cultures)
safety.note: In-vitro mitochondrial/cellular toxicity assays predicted 4'-Ed4T would spare mitochondria relative to stavudine; later 19-day primary kidney, muscle and adipocyte cultures agreed.
safety.short: Cell assays predict stavudine-like toxicity absent
safety.quote: After examining a series of 2',3'-didehydro-3'-deoxy-4'-substituted thymidine (4'-substituted D4T) analogs, 4'-ethynyl D4T was found to have a fivefold-better antiviral effect and to cause less cellular and mitochondrial toxicity than D4T.
safety.judgement: Safety track is the in-vitro mitochondrial package, opened with the member's own first paper; Wang 2013 (10.1128/AAC.01206-13) later showed no mtDNA loss in 19-day primary human kidney, muscle and adipocyte cultures at the 600 mg Cmax and at 200 uM, and Cihlar 2008 claimed low mitochondrial-toxicity potential for GS-9148. Kept apart from the animal toxicology track, which is a different system.

safety.model: DNA polymerase-gamma / mtDNA-depletion assays in cell culture (CEM; later 19-day primary human kidney, muscle and adipocyte cultures)
safety.note: Phase 2b: no stavudine-like lipoatrophy and less bone loss than tenofovir DF, as predicted; unpredicted limb/trunk fat gain and cholesterol rise.
safety.quote: Compared with tenofovir disoproxil fumarate, individuals in the BMS-986001 groups showed a smaller decrease in lumbar spine and hip bone mineral density but greater accumulation of limb and trunk fat, subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue, and increased total cholesterol.
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; whether the paper itself juxtaposes the mtDNA data is unverified (Lancet HIV full text paywalled).
safety.magnitude_basis: predicted absence of mitochondrial-type toxicity (lipoatrophy, neuropathy) held; the cell assay gives no incidence prediction
safety.judgement: Scored same with source_calls_it partial: the stated prediction (no stavudine-like mitochondrial toxicity) held, with no lipoatrophy and less bone loss than tenofovir DF, but the trial also found fat accumulation and cholesterol rises the cell system was silent on. Not counted as a contradicted silence because a 19-day mtDNA assay in dishes cannot show visceral fat gain in a person. comparison_stated false, model side Wang 2013. GS-9131 (21 participants, at most 14 days) and azvudine (no published HIV safety data; its COVID-19 real-world hepatotoxicity reports are another indication with no stated model prediction) add nothing to this track.

safety.model: Chronic rat and monkey toxicology (6- and 9-month studies)
safety.note: Chronic rat/monkey toxicology: bone-marrow dyserythropoiesis, immune-mediated platelet falls in 3/60 high-dose monkeys, no mitochondrial toxicity; published after the Phase 2a.
safety.short: Rat/monkey tox: marrow, platelets, no mito
safety.quote: The primary toxicity of BMS-986001 in rats and monkeys is bone marrow dyserythropoiesis with associated decreases in red blood cell mass.
safety.judgement: Animal track opened at its first public date; the studies themselves preceded the 2009 Phase 2a but are not separately dated, so model_first_use_year is 2014. Stated predictions: marrow dyserythropoiesis with reduced red-cell mass, immune-mediated thrombocytopenia at 200-300 mg/kg/d in 3 of 60 monkeys, and no mitochondrial toxicity in either species.

safety.model: Chronic rat and monkey toxicology (6- and 9-month studies)
safety.note: Phase 2b: one drug-related thrombocytopenia SAE among 198 censavudine patients and no mitochondrial-type toxicity, in line with the monkey findings.
safety.short: Monkey platelet signal: one patient SAE
safety.quote: Two patients had BMS-986001-related serious adverse events (atypical drug eruption and thrombocytopenia) and two in the tenofovir disoproxil fumarate group had study drug-related serious adverse events (potential drug-induced liver injury and depression or lipodystrophy) that led to discontinuation.
safety.confidence_note: One drug-related thrombocytopenia SAE in 198 patients read against a 3/60 high-dose monkey platelet finding; abstract-level, no statement that the paper links them; anaemia or dyserythropoiesis in patients is not reported in the abstract.
safety.magnitude_basis: predicted low-frequency platelet harm appeared once in 198; no incidence prediction stated by the model
safety.reason: Monkey platelet signal: one patient SAE
safety.judgement: Low-confidence same: one censavudine-related thrombocytopenia SAE in 198 patients is directionally what the monkey finding predicted, and the absence of mitochondrial toxicity matched too; anaemia or dyserythropoiesis in patients is not reported in the abstract, and the abstract does not link the SAE to the monkey data (model side Guha 2014 via model_src). A stricter reader treating one case as noise would leave this track untested rather than contra, since the predicted harm did appear. imported_from null: same indication.

safety.model: hOAT1/hOAT3/MRP4 transport cells, human renal cortex uptake and [14C]GS-9131 dog kidney accumulation
safety.note: hOAT1-transfected cells, human renal cortex and dog kidney accumulation predicted low nephrotoxic potential for GS-9148; GS-9131 patients were dosed 14 days only.
safety.short: Renal model never compared in patients
safety.quote: Collectively, these results suggest that GS-9148 exhibits a low potential for renal accumulation and nephrotoxicity.
safety.judgement: Separate track for GS-9148's renal-transport model (hOAT1/hOAT3/MRP4 cells, human renal cortex, dog kidney accumulation), the published answer to tenofovir-class nephrotoxicity. GS-9131 was dosed for at most 14 days in 21 participants with no posted renal safety data, so the prediction was never compared: untested, not empty. model_kind ex_vivo chosen for the transport cells, with the dog arm noted here.
